🏢 MI HB 6251 — Michigan Data Centers Face Tougher Scrutiny

New rules are coming to Michigan that could slow down the construction of large data centers. Developers of these facilities – which include massive computer farms used for things like AI and cryptocurrency – will now need to submit detailed plans to the state’s Public Service Commission. ...
